programme.title: Led Zeppelin - Physical Graffiti: A Classic Album Under Review
programme.desc: This is a documentary film about the build-up, making, release, and music contained on this most revered of albums. This is the complete story behind what Rolling Stone called their Tommy, Beggars Banquet and Sgt. Pepper rolled into one.

programme.title: Kiss - Live in Nürburgring
programme.desc: KISS impress an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than two hours and packed with hits, held at the Nürburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Grace Mitchell - Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Blondie -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, giving all fans an experience; Blondie performs their hits including "Heart of Glass," "Euphoria," "Mile High" and many more.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live at Hyde Park
programme.desc: Experience the legendary Rod Stewart as he closes Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day with a memorable performance in September 2015 at London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: Michael Bublé: Caught in the Act
programme.desc: "Caught in the Act" is the second live album released by Canadian jazz crooner Michael Bublé. It was filmed and recorded at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles. The filmed concert was aired on PBS as an episode of Great Performances, and the show was subsequently released on DVD along with the audio CD to create the album package, although the audio disc only featured eight of the songs from the concert.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: The hits from the CD Duets II are beautifully recorded on the videos of studio recordings on the new Blu-ray, Duets II - The Great Performances.

programme.title: Bastille - Reading and Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England; featuring Bastille.

programme.title: David Gilmour - Remember That Night
programme.desc: David Gilmour - Remember That Night: Live at the Royal Albert Hall is recorded by guitarist David Gilmour where he presents live tracks from the album On an Island and some hits from his former band Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out 3-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in February 2008 when Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live in Hyde Park
programme.desc: "London Calling: Live in Hyde Park" is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this production of Guns N' Roses performing live at the O2 Arena featuring hits: Paradise City, Sweet Child O' Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Salif Keita : Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Features a concert from Salif Keita, a talented musician who combines Malian, European and American influences by using a range of both West African and Western European musical instruments.

programme.title: Special Edition at Estival 1985 - Jack DeJohnette, Howard Johnson, Greg Osby & John Purcell
programme.desc: Estival is a summer jazz festival in Lugano, Switzerland.

programme.title: Guitarlegend in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the unique and influential guitarists in music history. This rare footage illuminates Wes's extraordinary musical vocabulary and unconventional picking technique.

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Lionel Hampton
programme.desc: At Münchner Klaviersommer 1994, American swing band leader Lionel Hampton performs jazz standards with Junior Mance on piano, Jimmy Woode on bass and Bobby Durham on drums; they are joined by the St. Petersburg State Orchestra on two numbers.

programme.title: Raul Midón at Sing Jazz, Singapore 2017
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: In June 1962, tenor saxophonist Coleman Hawkins appears at the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, with a quartet for an hour-long set consisting mostly of familiar standards.

programme.title: Raul Midon at Singapore 2017
programme.desc: Raul Midón appears at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams.

programme.title: Newport Jazz Festival 1968

programme.title: The Blue Note Masters -- Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson, Javon Jackson & Joe Chambers
programme.desc: Explore how Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers establish themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist; she brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres.

programme.title: Kenny Barron at Lviv Ukraine 2019
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv is a celebration of jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Jo Jones and Milt Buckner Live at Radio Télévision Suisse
programme.desc: In early Sept. 1969, the duo of American drummer Papa Jo Jones, 1911-1985 and American organist Milt Buckner, 1915-1977, played a string of jazz concerts in Switzerland.

programme.title: Raul Midón at Sing Jazz, Singapore 2017

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis (piano), Percy Heath (bass), and Connie Kay (drums). Jackson and Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's big band.

programme.title: Jacques Loussier in Lepzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio performs a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig.

programme.title: Fannie Mae
programme.desc: Jaco Pastorius, a true musical innovator, takes the stage at the Montreal Jazz Festival; he is transforming the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument, wowing the audience in Canada with his unique style and talent.

programme.title: Charles Mingus and Eric Dolphy Live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases a concert performed in April 1965 featuring Jaki Byard on piano, Dannie Richmond on drums, Johnny Coles on trumpet, Clifford Jordan on tenor sax and Eric Dolphy on alto sax, flute and bass clarinet.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas: Live at Casino de Paris
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris shows the British singer-songwriter at her best; this concert is part of La Havas' "Blood Tour", promoting her second album "Blood."

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: With 'Red Earth', American singer Dee Dee Bridgewater goes on a Malian journey that merges & melds all borders. She brings her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland, resulting in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: Zoo Clues
programme.desc: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues."

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth
programme.desc: If you're expecting this show to feature locations like Antarctica and the North Pole, you may be disappointed because the "coolest" in the title refers to how impressive a place is, not its temperature. Instead, the show explores the history and culture of cities and landmarks that are among the most astonishing sites on the planet. Each episode features three locations, showcasing the history, geography and traditions of each to help young people gain a better understanding of the diverse world in which they live.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. Cats are celebrated for their physical prowess, with their running, jumping and climbing skills second to no other animal in the world. Species featured on the show include caracals jumping to reach their prey, Siberian tigers in their natural landscape and rare footage reveals Bornean bay cats in action.

programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time, using raw and unfiltered footage, including body-cam and surveillance footage, to bring out the truth.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is R&B musician Babylon! This artist made his big debut in 2015 with the single PRAY and immediately captured listeners' hearts with his unusual soulful vibes. Then he engraved his names in the minds of the public by featuring in ZICO's Boys And Girls which led him to collaborate with a number of top artists in the industry including Verbal Zint The Quiett Nucksal BewhY Suzy Chungha Yubin and more. This February Babylon returned to the industry with his much-anticipated new album Hardy packed to the brim with collaborations and songs. One of the lead singles Alone was written composed and produced by Lee Hyo-ri and another lead single Like Song features top rapper Jay Park. Babylon also worked with Kid Milli Coogie KYLE LO Samuel Seo Lee Young-ji Queen WA$ABII and more for the album. In this episode Babylon performs Like Song Dawn Fog Chandelier Red Lipstick and White Suit to showcase the essence of his musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band MACGUFFIN! This band is composed of drummer SNOOQ vocalist and guitarist Byeon Ha-geum bassist UHI and guitarist Bae Joon-il. The band is named after a technique of the same name that advances a film's plot builds the narrative and helps push the story forward widely popularized by Alfred Hitchcock. Back in 2017 the quartet participated in the Arirang Competition and won the Grand Prize with their unique interpretation of Arirang. Then in 2018 they won the Golden Prize at the Penta Super Rookie and engraved their name in the minds of the public. The members recently completed their mandatory military duties and are so ready to impress listeners with their matured musicality. In this episode MACGUFFIN performs Sinpa Bucket List Highway and more to showcase their artistic prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the soulful singer-songwriter GSoul! GSoul is a big name in the music industry. Known for his exceptional soulful voice and songwriting skills he garnered much attention even before his official debut. To further engrave his name in the minds of the public he took part in the competition show “Voice Korea 2020” last year and won first place impressing everyone with his outstanding musicality once again. This past February this artist released the duet Can Love Be Fair? with Ben to depict a couple experiencing unequal love. GSoul's soulful vocals definitely make this song more heartrending. In this episode GSoul performs Hate Everything Bad Habits Let Me Know Another Sad Love Song Broken Record as well as his solo version of Can Love Be Fair? Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and let this artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kwon Jin-ah! This artist became known to the public in 2013 after taking part in K-Pop Star Season 3. 3 years later in 2016 she made her official debut with the album One Strange Night and topped all the music charts with the lead single The End. Particularly known for her delicate ability to express emotions she has collaborated with various top-notch musicians and also taken part in many soundtracks. This past February Kwon Jin-ah released her first collaborative single with Gaeko I Feel Like and dominated the top spots of music charts again. February was definitely a busy month for this artist - she also released her EP The Way For Us. Due to her active participation in the creative process both as a songwriter and producer the album beautifully displays her distinct musicality. She likens each of her songs in the EP to a short story making her new album a collection of 6 short stories. In this episode Kwon Jin-ah performs Something's Wrong Flower Heart You already have Good Bye I got lucky and The way for Us. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy her beautiful songs!

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: Volvo Cars and Epic Games bring real-time photorealistic visualisation
programme.desc: To offer its customers the best possible user experience, Volvo Cars is bringing photorealistic visualisation technology into its next generation of electric cars through a new collaboration with Epic Games. The companies are teaming up to bring Epic's Unreal Engine game engine into upcoming Volvo cars, providing unparalleled high-quality graphics inside the cabin. Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment and software company probably best known for Fortnite, one of the world's largest games. Epic Games also develops Unreal Engine, widely considered to be the most advanced real-time 3D creation tool used in various industries beyond games, and which will now be used by Volvo Cars for developing digital interfaces inside its cars and rendering real-time graphics in the car.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

Sam converts their underutilized spare bedroom into a hip, eco-friendly nursery using bright colours, contemporary baby furniture, colourful accessories and natural materials.
